name: blueprint-atelier
vibe: The film is drafted like an engineering drawing on a living drafting table: a blue graph-paper sheet with edge rulers, a slow compass rose, a wandering crosshair with a live X/Y readout, dimension lines that draw themselves with a trailing pencil, dashed-box flowcharts, a scanning output plot, red revision strike-throughs, rubber stamps, and a sheet-wipe between every scene. Deep engineering blue with amber, cyan and red ink; Space Grotesk display over IBM Plex Mono chrome. Rendered as a native GSAP + SVG/CSS composition.
